groups.activity: check the research console before farming

rows.label: Catabolyst
rows.note: 3,000cr, 40 Mutagen Sample, 650 Plastids, 3,750 Salvage, 4,250 Nano Spores, 3 days

conditions: You don't need to own or build Acrid or Embolist yourself; the clan's Bio Lab just needs the research completed.
Costs listed are for a solo x1 clan; larger clan tiers multiply them up to x100. In an established clan it's usually done already.
Catabolyst is untradeable; the Coda Catabolyst from Eleanor's shop is a separate weapon and does not substitute here.

rows.label: Scintillant
rows.note: floats inside vaults; also drops from hostile Necramechs and Mother's bounties
rows.alt: Lvl 15-25 bounty Stage 1, 18.42% for a roll instead

conditions: Complete a vault's normal Isolation Vault bounty first — no Arcana bounty exists for a vault until you have.
Starting the Arcana bounty resets the cave and respawns floating Scintillant in the same spots; leave to abandon after grabbing it and keep the pickup.
If a vault has no Scintillant floating, roll a different one from Mother instead of looping it.
Resource and Drop Chance boosters affect floating pickups and Necramech/Obelisk drops but do nothing for bounty reward rolls.
bonuses: Loot Detector, Thief's Wit or Animal Instinct shows Scintillant on the minimap by its buzzing loop.
Necramechs in vaults can drop Scintillant and can be Desecrated by Nekros.

rows.label: reach Rank 2 Acquaintance
rows.note: gate for the Stellated Necrathene refine blueprint

conditions: The same Mother's bounties that rank you up also drop Scintillant, so this doubles as the vault farming above.

groups.activity: buy the Stellated Necrathene refine blueprint

rows.label: Stellated Necrathene refine Blueprint
rows.note: reusable; each craft takes 6 Necrathene + 1,000cr for 6

conditions: Catabolyst needs 10 Stellated Necrathene, so two crafts (12 raw Necrathene) covers it with 2 to spare.

rows.label: Necrathene
rows.note: teal/blue mining veins; also drops from Requiem Obelisks; refines into 10 Stellated Necrathene across 2 crafts

rows.label: Ocular Stem-Root
rows.note: 1 per Flagellocanth filleted at Daughter; also drops from Isolation Vault bounties

conditions: Flagellocanth is a rare surface hotspot fish; bait with Processed Fass Residue at Actuary's Pride (Fass) or Cerebrum Magna (Vome).

rows.label: Mutagen Mass
rows.note: own Bio Lab blueprint, 15,000cr; each build 12h, queue all 7 at once
rows.alt: Orb Vallis 30-50 level bounties can award crafted Mutagen Mass directly

rows.label: Catabolyst
rows.note: 30,000cr, 5 Scintillant, 4 Ocular Stem-Root, 7 Mutagen Mass, 10 Stellated Necrathene; 1 day

conditions: The weapon never auto-reloads by design — reloading from empty is what powers the grenade throw.

disclosures.title: skip the single-use blueprint loop
disclosures.body: A Mutagen Mass is not a Mutagen Sample; each Mass is its own single-use dojo blueprint craft from Mutagen Samples plus common resources. Orb Vallis bounties can award crafted Mutagen Mass directly as a reward, bypassing the Sample conversion entirely.
